design.filter: hypothesis_trrust3.py build(): top-10 genes, upper-case, drop ENSG*, unique, >= 2 genes
design.universe: python-sorted raw gene strings seen in any top-20 list of the model (catalogue index order of pipeline.py)
design.tie_tail: trailing run of top-20 slots whose genes form alphabetical blocks (>= 3 genes, rank gaps <= 2)
design.clean: tie-tail slots blanked before the same filter
design.null: slot permutation across features (exact gene counts and feature sizes); duplicates fixed by random swaps
design.esm_cos: mean cosine of the UCE input tokens (ESM2 protein embeddings, unit-normalised) over the lcp/lev pair subsample, pairs with both genes embedded

token_sources.tGPT: tokenizer.json of lixiangchun/transcriptome-gpt-1024-8-16-64 (WordLevel; ids in corpus-frequency order)
token_sources.Geneformer: token_dictionary_gc104M.pkl (ids in Ensembl-id order) via gene_name_id_dict_gc104M.pkl
token_sources.MaxToki: same gc104M dictionaries as Geneformer (adapters/maxtoki.py: shared 20,275 vocab)
token_sources.AIDO: OS_scRNA_gene_index.19264.tsv gene position index (same list as scFoundation)
token_sources.UCE: key order of Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.gene_symbol_to_embedding_ESM2.pt (UCE per-species token order)

tGPT.token_order: tokenizer.json of lixiangchun/transcriptome-gpt-1024-8-16-64 (WordLevel; ids in corpus-frequency order)

GeneCompass.token_order: not available on disk; alphabetical order only

Tahoe.token_order: not available on disk; alphabetical order only
